name: career-copilot
description: Runs your LinkedIn-centred job search with you — without logging into LinkedIn, scraping it, or sending anything on its own.
long_description: Career Copilot tiers job-alert emails into matched / promising / close, plans the skills blocking your targets, triages recruiter messages and flags scams, audits your LinkedIn profile against its character limits, and ranks industry news. Every message, post, application and profile edit stays a draft until you approve it yourself, in a browser page or a terminal, and carry it out on LinkedIn by hand. It never asks for your LinkedIn password or session cookie, and nothing it does touches LinkedIn's servers. All of your data stays on this machine.

tools.name: add_course
tools.description: Track a course or certification the user chose.

tools.name: add_job
tools.description: Add a job the user found or pasted.

tools.name: audit_profile
tools.description: Audit the LinkedIn profile against target roles and in-demand skills from stored jobs.

tools.name: build_learning_plan
tools.description: Time-boxed learning plan from the skill gaps, with a proof-of-skill idea per step and how many jobs would move up a tier if the user closed each gap.

tools.name: check_sponsor_licence
tools.description: Whether a UK job's employer appears on the Home Office Register of Licensed Sponsors.

tools.name: draft_application
tools.description: Queue an application note or cover message for a job, for approval.

tools.name: draft_comment
tools.description: Queue a comment on a LinkedIn post (max 1,250 characters) for approval.

tools.name: draft_message_reply
tools.description: Queue a reply to an inbox item for the user's approval.

tools.name: draft_outreach
tools.description: Queue a connection note or message to a recruiter, hiring manager or referral, for approval.

tools.name: draft_post
tools.description: Queue a LinkedIn post (max 3,000 characters) for approval.

tools.name: fetch_job_description
tools.description: Fetch a stored job's full description from its job-board page and re-score it.

tools.name: fetch_missing_descriptions
tools.description: Fill in descriptions for stored jobs that lack one, newest first, and re-score them.

tools.name: find_referrals
tools.description: First-degree connections (from the imported LinkedIn export) who work at this job's company.

tools.name: get_approved_actions
tools.description: Drafts the user approved but hasn't done yet, with step-by-step instructions for doing them on LinkedIn.

tools.name: get_audit_log
tools.description: Recent entries of the append-only audit log (who did what, when).

tools.name: get_gmail_status
tools.description: Whether Gmail is connected, when it was last synced, and which senders are in scope.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Full details of one job: description, score breakdown, matched and missing skills, reasons.

tools.name: get_news_digest
tools.description: Top recent news and LinkedIn digest posts ranked by the user's interests and skill gaps.

tools.name: get_skill_gaps
tools.description: Skills that most often block the user's matched/promising/close jobs, with course search links.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Overview: jobs per tier, open inbox items, drafts awaiting the user's approval, courses, and reminders.

tools.name: import_linkedin_export
tools.description: Import LinkedIn's official data export ZIP (Settings → Data privacy → Get a copy of your data).

tools.name: import_sponsor_register
tools.description: Import the UK Register of Licensed Sponsors CSV, downloaded by the user from gov.uk.

tools.name: ingest_email
tools.description: Store a notification email the user received: LinkedIn job alerts, message/InMail notifications, invitations, application updates and digests, plus Bayt/GulfTalent/NaukriGulf/Wuzzuf job alerts.

tools.name: list_courses
tools.description: Tracked courses and certifications.

tools.name: list_drafts
tools.description: List drafts by status, with their automatic checks (length, numbers to verify, links, flags).

tools.name: list_inbox
tools.description: Messages, invitations and application updates that need attention, highest priority first.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: List jobs by fit.

tools.name: mark_executed
tools.description: Record that the user did an approved action on LinkedIn.

tools.name: propose_profile_edit
tools.description: Queue a LinkedIn profile change for approval.

tools.name: refresh_news
tools.description: Fetch the RSS/Atom feeds configured in profile.toml (https only) and rank new items by the user's interests.

tools.name: revise_draft
tools.description: Replace the text of a draft that is still pending review.

tools.name: sync_gmail
tools.description: Read recent job-alert and notification emails straight from the user's Gmail (read-only scope) and ingest them, so message bodies never pass through this conversation.

tools.name: update_course
tools.description: Update course progress or status.

tools.name: update_inbox_item
tools.description: Change an inbox item's status, e.g.

tools.name: update_job
tools.description: Update a job: paste its full description (re-scores it), move it through the pipeline, or add notes.

tools.name: withdraw_draft
tools.description: Withdraw a pending draft that is no longer needed.

data_directory.title: Data folder
data_directory.description: Where your profile, job database and drafts are kept. Stays on this machine; nothing is uploaded.
